- **Genetic confirmation:** Positive HTT gene CAG repeat expansion (definitive diagnostic test).

- Brain MRI shows caudate nucleus atrophy with secondary ex vacuo dilatation of the frontal horns — hallmark neuroimaging finding in HD.

- Motor features include uncharacterized involuntary movements (typical of early HD chorea) and new-onset dysphagia — indicating progression into oropharyngeal motor circuit involvement, common in mid-stage HD.

Huntington disease
